jobs.title: CARGO STORAGE

No outer posts, rails, surroundingropes, pallet, snow or added rack.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished HAVENLINE ground-plot 360-degree concept turnaround sheet. Source gameplay crops are the authority for physical footprint, borders, colors and pictograms. Prior Havenline resource art is for stock-item materials only. Flat plot decals stay FLAT and nearly ground-flush, no thick base, podium, wood floor, fencing, pillars, rope, snowy mound or building. Clean dark navy studio floor/background, no scene or characters. Landscape sheet, clearly readable heading, exactlyFOURcolumns byTWOrows, equal panels, generous margins. Same whole plot and same attached graphics/stock rotated clockwise about vertical axis; fixed orthographic-like camera35degrees above ground so the top remains visible. TOP ROW: FRONT0°, FRONT RIGHT45°, RIGHT90°, REAR RIGHT135°. BOTTOM ROW: REAR180°, REAR LEFT225°, LEFT270°, FRONT LEFT315°. Distinct opposite and diagonal directions. At0front edge horizontal nearest viewer. At45front edge slopes down-left-to-right and right edge is visible, while225has the opposite back face in the same diagonal.135and315 use the opposite diagonal. All artwork and cost symbols are printed flat ON THE GROUND PLANE and rotate physically with the same plot; in rear180 the artwork is upside down to the camera, and90/270 it is sideways. Never redraw glyphs to face the camera in every view. Panel view labels remain upright outside the asset. Uniform object scale and fixed soft studio lighting. Rounded polished readable game-resource materials; no photographic pores or gritty medieval styling. Small footer '360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND'. No watermark or copied game UI.

Exact title: HAVENLINE / CARGO STORAGE. FIRST reference is the independently accepted EMPTY STORAGE PAD and full-sheet layout master. SECOND reference is original video storage behavior. THIRD reference is the approved resource artwork for stock identity. Use source pad geometry, never convert the pad to a platform or structural storage bin.

Same footprint in every panel, width1.35 times front-to-back depth, softly rounded corners. The pad is almost zero-thickness, a ground decal with no raised foundation, bevel-wall, planks, posts, rails, surrounding ropes, snow, curb or stone ring. The centered resource pictogram is flat painted 2D art fixed to the top surface, never a physical resource and never billboarded. Leave generous visible dark border between stock and perimeter. All8 panels show exactly the same pad, stock and anchored pictogram rotating together. The asset is isolated on navy background, no warm rectangular terrain slab underneath.

RIGID CENTER ANCHOR: the painted type pictogram sits EXACTLY at the pad geometric center (intersection of diagonals). The physical stock arrangement is also centered over it and rotates as ONE assembly with the whole pad. The stock is allowed to obscure all or most of the glyph; do not move the glyph or stock toward an empty area for readability. Front0 and rear180 have opposite faces but the stock footprint stays at the pad center.90/270 are opposite ends,45/225 same diagonal with opposite surfaces,135/315 opposite diagonal. No billboarding and no restacking between views.

PAD ORBIT IS MANDATORY: the pad perimeter rotates with its stock. FRONT0 and REAR180 show broad horizontal edges; RIGHT90 and LEFT270 show narrower horizontal edges with the pad long dimension receding into depth.45 and225 show one oblique diamond/parallelogram orientation;135 and315 show the opposite oblique diagonal. Never keep a front-facing trapezoid under an independently turning item.

The90/270 end-view pad silhouettes MUST be visibly narrower AND deeper than0/180, matching the FIRST-reference projections. At1536×1024 layout the master end pads are roughly245px wide ×160px deep, versus front pads roughly310px wide ×135px deep. Keep scale stable and35° elevation; do not use broad/shallow front pads beneath rotated end views. The full continuous perimeter stays clear except natural stock occlusion.

IMPORTANT225 top ropes must slope in the opposite screen diagonal from135, same projected diagonal pattern as45, while being physically unchanged.270 plain LEFT side;315 LEFT plain onimageLEFT+front brace/tag onimageRIGHT. Keep lid,2ropes,cap count and one handle fixed. Crate base about50% padwidth with perimeter clear. A single flat crate glyph centered underneath may be completely hidden. jobs.title: HIDE STORAGE
jobs.design: Exactly ONE tan folded hide centered flat on pad, same folded-in-half hide as approved reference. Broad supple honey-tan leather surface, softly wavy edges, no fur, no stitching or ties, one gently uneven front open flap with a small V-shaped notch toward FRONT-LEFT. Same thickness, one fold, dark interior gap and notch remain physically fixed.0 shows broad open front edge and notchleft;45 shows openfront onimageLEFT plus right folded end onimageRIGHT;90 rightend with opening towardimageLEFT;135 rear-right corner with rightend opening onimageLEFT and smooth closedfold/rear onimageRIGHT;180 closed rounded fold across rear with no frontgap;225 opposite rear-left corner with closedrear onimageLEFT and left openend onimageRIGHT;270 mirrored leftend with gap opening towardimageRIGHT;315 front-left corner with notch returning on nearimageLEFT/front flap. Copy approved silhouette and orbit rather than inventing anew fold. Hide is one low soft material piece about60% padwidth, not a pelt carpet or groundfloor. One flat tan hide pictogram centered underneath may be completely covered. No skull, feet, body parts, rack, straps or sewing tools.
